transientTurnCommitRetry.requiredName: retries an idempotent durable commit before publishing the completed terminal

permanentTurnCommitFailClosed.requiredName: fails the live canonical terminal closed when the completed turn cannot commit

lostSqliteCommitAcknowledgement.requiredName: adopts one exact history when SQLite committed but the first commit acknowledgement was lost

orderedBlockLedger.requiredName: persists ordered block decisions and atomically settles mixed/all-reverted reviews

runtimeBlockRecovery.requiredName: settles prose review blocks durably and retries an entered block inverse during project hydration

localProjectionLoss.requiredName: rebuilds a lost inline review from file SQLite and settles mixed blocks against Yjs

postYjsSettlementFault.requiredName: recovers when Yjs reverted but the durable block-settlement acknowledgement failed

unrelatedAuthorEdit.requiredName: preserves unrelated author edits while reverting only the certified Agent block

sameBlockAuthorConflict.requiredName: refuses to overwrite author text changed after the Agent edit

yjsPersistenceRetry.requiredName: retries idempotently when Yjs changed but the first persistence acknowledgement failed

rejectedAnimationDirection.requiredName: turns every bulk rejection into the visible inverse animation

nativeScrollRevealCoordinates.requiredName: keeps reveal coordinates stable inside the native scrolling content tree

sqliteProjectionWins.requiredName: replaces stale local decisions with the exact SQLite-backed projection

boundaries.nativeAnimationAppearance: direction and selection are deterministic; visual smoothness remains user/native acceptance
boundaries.deviceRestart: file/process restart is headless; platform lifecycle acceptance remains milestone J
boundaries.providerNetwork: not required for storage semantics; multi-provider conformance remains milestone I
